hero_description: The most powerful blocker designed to help you overcome internet addictions through intelligent site filtering and behavior-shaping scripts.
features_section_description: Simple to setup, impossible to ignore. Ace Blocker provides the tools you need to stay on track.
feature_blocks_description: Advanced network-level blocking that's difficult to bypass, ensuring you stay away from distractions when you need to most.
feature_scripts_description: Inject scripts that make addictive sites less visually appealing, breaking the dopamine loops that keep you scrolling.
feature_analytics_description: Visualize your progress and see exactly how much time you've reclaimed since starting your journey with Ace Blocker.
